fieldMarks: Dark tail underside, unlike white-tailed cottontails
Short rounded ears and small feet; long toenails on hind feet
Dark to reddish-brown, dark belly, sparse fur
behavior: Strong swimmer; dives into water to escape predators
Rests in grass nests by day
habitat: Lowland freshwater marshes and estuarine areas below about 152 m, near permanent water.
range: Southeastern US: southeast Virginia, southern Georgia, eastern Alabama, Florida peninsula and coastal islands; largest population in the Great Dismal Swamp.

lookalikes.name: Eastern cottontail
lookalikes.howToTell: Larger head and tail; tail underside white.

lookalikes.name: Swamp rabbit
lookalikes.howToTell: Related but distinct species (source gives no field mark).
